sources.title: Primary source 1: http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29718v2

claims.text: The authors identify premature termination as a long-context failure mode in long-horizon search.

limitations.text: The evidence is the authors' arXiv paper/model card and reported evaluations; results are not independently reproduced in this Evidence review.

targets.target: verify model/benchmark set and correlation evidence
targets.finding: The study evaluates four flagship models across three long-horizon search benchmarks and links longer context to a higher rate of premature termination; it also compares seven context-management methods.
